outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173081666.jpeg - The image features a person on horseback in a desert landscape with a rising sun, which visually represents the proverb 'Whoever walks with faith never gets lost in the hinterland' and the regional setting.

outline.title: 04. Experiência do Cliente
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173080204.jpeg - The image of a campfire and an owl under a starry sky directly illustrates the proverb 'The fire that warms the heart also illuminates the paths', connecting to the theme of customer experience and warmth.

outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173078792.jpeg - The image shows a rustic house with a dog and a cactus under a moonlit sky, which visually represents the proverb 'Prosperity is having roots, roof, and affection', relating to the management of stock and products as foundational elements.

outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173077267.jpeg - The image of a lantern illuminating a path at night with a moth flying towards it directly illustrates the proverb 'A small light is enough to change the whole night', which is relevant to marketing and visual identity as a guiding light.

outline.title: 07. Gestão de Estoque
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173085743.jpeg - The image features a rustic, woodcut-style illustration with elements like a cactus, a house, and a fire, which evokes a sense of regional culture and aligns with the operational and logistical aspects of a business rooted in a specific location like Aracaju.

outline.title: 08. Custos de Implantação

outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/Yvienendeeso_content/images/image_1782173073803.jpeg - The image of an owl and a cactus under a full moon, with the proverb 'The night also teaches those who know how to listen', visually represents the themes of security and sustainability, suggesting wisdom and resilience in challenging times.
